result:
The manifest has been written to `/out/manifest.json` and passed the lint hook (which checks full file coverage and effect-signal consistency).

Summary: partitioned the `psf/requests` (`dae7ef6`) source tree into 19 logical units at `src/requests/*.py` module granularity — 9 `domain` units (status-codes, exceptions, hooks, cookie-jar, auth-handlers, http-models, session, functional-api, package-bootstrap) and 10 `infra` units (version-metadata, compat-shims, internal-string-utils, type-definitions, data-structures, ca-certs, utils, transport-adapters, legacy-package-shim, diagnostics). Each unit lists its entrypoints (with `file:line`), its dependencies on other units' specific entrypoints, and its real runtime effects (network, filesystem, env, clock, random, other). All non-`src/requests` files (tests, docs, ext, CI, packaging/config, license/changelog, and the schema itself) are itemized under `excluded` with reasons — individually for `.py` files, by directory for other asset types. `unpartitioned` is empty since every in-scope source file was assigned. I also flagged 4 `violations_observed` where one unit reaches into another's underscore-prefixed private symbols (e.g. `adapters.py` and `sessions.py` both importing `auth._basic_auth_str`; `models.py` importing `cookies._copy_cookie_jar`).
